"Explore the wonderful cuisines of Asia without leaving home. Enjoy the fresh flavors and delicious variety of dishes from China, Southeast Asia, Japan and Korea. You'll find recipes for classics including Pad Thai, Sweet and Sour Pork and California Roll Sushi, plus quick and easy rice and noodle dishes. Chinese Cooking & More will guide you with tested recipes that use familiar techniques. Clear instructions and a glossary of Asian ingredients make it easy to succeed with every recipe every time."--Pg. 4 of cover
